Elements.Script: local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer; getgenv().SelectedRarity = {'All'}; getgenv().SelectedBrainrots = {'All'}; getgenv().AutoFarmEnabled = false; local function getNormalTemplates() local success, folder = pcall(function() return game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage').Brainrots.Normal end); return success and folder or nil end; local function getVariants() local vars = {}; pcall(function() local content = lp.PlayerGui.ScreenUis.IndexFrame.Header.VariantDropdown.Content; for _, v in ipairs(content:GetChildren()) do if v:IsA('TextButton') and not table.find(vars, v.Name) then table.insert(vars, v.Name) end end end); return vars end; local function getCleanName(name) local templates = getNormalTemplates(); if templates and templates:FindFirstChild(name) then return name end; local variants = getVariants(); local cleaned = name; local changed = true; while changed do changed = false; for _, v in ipairs(variants) do if cleaned:sub(1, #v) == v then cleaned = cleaned:sub(#v + 1); cleaned = cleaned:match('^%s*(.-)%s*$'); changed = true; break end end if templates and templates:FindFirstChild(cleaned) then break end end; return cleaned end; local function getRarities() local rars = {'All'}; local folder = getNormalTemplates(); if folder then for _, v in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do local gui = v:FindFirstChild('BrainrotGui'); local rarity = gui and gui:FindFirstChild('Rarity'); if rarity and rarity:IsA('TextLabel') then local text = rarity.Text; if not table.find(rars, text) then table.insert(rars, text) end end end end; return rars end; local function getFilteredBrainrots() local names = {'All'}; local selRar = getgenv().SelectedRarity; local folder = getNormalTemplates(); if folder then for _, v in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do local isRarityMatch = false; if type(selRar) == 'table' then if selRar['All'] then isRarityMatch = true else local gui = v:FindFirstChild('BrainrotGui'); local rarity = gui and gui:FindFirstChild('Rarity'); if rarity and rarity:IsA('TextLabel') and selRar[rarity.Text] then isRarityMatch = true end end elseif selRar == 'All' then isRarityMatch = true end; if isRarityMatch then table.insert(names, v.Name) end end end; return names end; local brainrotDrop; Value:AddDropdown('RaritySelector', {Title = 'Select Rarity', Values = getRarities(), Default = {'All'}, Multi = true, Callback = function(V) getgenv().SelectedRarity = V; local newItems = getFilteredBrainrots(); if brainrotDrop then pcall(function() brainrotDrop:SetValues(newItems) end) end; getgenv().SelectedBrainrots = {'All'} end}); brainrotDrop = Value:AddDropdown('BrainrotSelector', {Title = 'Select Brainrots', Values = getFilteredBrainrots(), Default = {'All'}, Multi = true, Callback = function(V) getgenv().SelectedBrainrots = V end}); local function isItemSelected(instance) local cName = getCleanName(instance.Name); local selRar = getgenv().SelectedRarity; if type(selRar) == 'table' and not selRar['All'] then local templates = getNormalTemplates(); if templates then local template = templates:FindFirstChild(cName); local gui = template and template:FindFirstChild('BrainrotGui'); local rarity = gui and gui:FindFirstChild('Rarity'); if not rarity or not selRar[rarity.Text] then return false end end end; local selected = getgenv().SelectedBrainrots; if not selected then return false end; if type(selected) ~= 'table' then return selected == 'All' or selected == cName end; local hasSpecific = false; local foundMatch = false; for k, v in pairs(selected) do local val = (type(k) == 'number' and v or k); local isSelected = (type(v) == 'boolean' and v or true); if isSelected then if val ~= 'All' then hasSpecific = true end; if val == cName then foundMatch = true end end end; if hasSpecific then return foundMatch end; for k, v in pairs(selected) do local val = (type(k) == 'number' and v or k); local isSelected = (type(v) == 'boolean' and v or true); if isSelected and val == 'All' then return true end end; return false end; Value:AddToggle('FarmToggle', {Title = 'Auto Take', Default = false, Callback = function(V) getgenv().AutoFarmEnabled = V; if V then task.spawn(function() while getgenv().AutoFarmEnabled do pcall(function() local carried = lp:GetAttribute('CarriedBrainrot') ~= nil; if carried then local collectZone = workspace:FindFirstChild('CollectZone'); local touchInterest = collectZone and collectZone:FindFirstChild('TouchInterest', true); local attempts = 0; repeat local root = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart'); if touchInterest and touchInterest.Parent and root then firetouchinterest(root, touchInterest.Parent, 0); task.wait(); firetouchinterest(root, touchInterest.Parent, 1) end; task.wait(0.2); attempts = attempts + 1 until not getgenv().AutoFarmEnabled or lp:GetAttribute('CarriedBrainrot') == nil or attempts > 15 else local brainrots = workspace:FindFirstChild('Brainrots'); if brainrots then local target = nil; local targetPrompt = nil; for _, br in ipairs(brainrots:GetChildren()) do if isItemSelected(br) then local p = br:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('ProximityPrompt', true); if p and p.Enabled then target = br; targetPrompt = p; break end end end; if target and targetPrompt and targetPrompt.Parent and lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') then local root = lp.Character.HumanoidRootPart; local pAttempts = 0; repeat if target and target.Parent and targetPrompt.Enabled and targetPrompt.Parent:IsA('BasePart') then root.CFrame = targetPrompt.Parent.CFrame; fireproximityprompt(targetPrompt) end; task.wait(0.2); pAttempts = pAttempts + 1 until not getgenv().AutoFarmEnabled or not target or not target.Parent or not targetPrompt.Enabled or lp:GetAttribute('CarriedBrainrot') ~= nil or pAttempts > 15 end end end end); task.wait(0.1) end end) end end})

getgenv().AntiTrapEnabled = false; getgenv().AutoCollectPlot = false; getgenv().AutoRebirthEnabled = false; getgenv().AutoSellAllEnabled = false; local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer; local function getMyPlot() local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild('Plots'); if not plots then return nil end; for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do local ownerObj = plot:FindFirstChild('Owner'); local owner = plot:GetAttribute('Owner') or (ownerObj and ownerObj:IsA('StringValue') and ownerObj.Value) or (ownerObj and ownerObj:IsA('ObjectValue') and ownerObj.Value and ownerObj.Value.Name); if owner == lp.Name then return plot end end; return nil end; Value:AddToggle('DeleteTrapToggle', {Title = 'Delete Trap', Default = false, Callback = function(V) getgenv().AntiTrapEnabled = V; if V then task.spawn(function() while getgenv().AntiTrapEnabled do pcall(function() local traps = workspace:FindFirstChild('Traps'); if traps then for _, trap in ipairs(traps:GetChildren()) do trap:Destroy() end end end); task.wait(0.1) end end) end end}); Value:AddToggle('AutoCollectPlotToggle', {Title = 'Auto Collect', Default = false, Callback = function(V) getgenv().AutoCollectPlot = V; if root then for _, child in ipairs(collectButtons:GetChildren()) do local ti = child:FindFirstChild('TouchInterest'); if ti then firetouchinterest(root, child, 0); firetouchinterest(root, child, 1) end end end end end end); task.wait(1) end end) end end})

getgenv().AutoUpgradeEnabled = false; getgenv().SelectedUpgradeAmount = '+2'; Value:AddDropdown('UpgradeAmountSelector', {Title = 'Select Amount', Values = {'+2', '+10'}, Default = '+2', Multi = false, Callback = function(V) getgenv().SelectedUpgradeAmount = V end}); Value:AddToggle('AutoUpgradeToggle', {Title = 'Auto Jump Upgrade', Default = false, Callback = function(V) getgenv().AutoUpgradeEnabled = V; if V then task.spawn(function() while getgenv().AutoUpgradeEnabled do pcall(function() if getgenv().SelectedUpgradeAmount == '+2' then game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage').Remotes.UpgradeJump:FireServer() else game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage').Remotes.UpgradeJumpBulk:FireServer() end end); task.wait(0.1) end end) end end})
